v.1: Indeed We sent Noah to his people, [saying,] ‘Warn your people before a painful punishment overtakes them.’
v.2: He said, ‘O my people! Indeed, I am a manifest warner to you.
v.3: Worship Allah and be wary of Him, and obey me,
v.4: that He may forgive you some of your sins and respite you until a specified time. Indeed when Allah’s [appointed] time comes, it cannot be deferred, if you know.’
v.5: He said, ‘My Lord! Indeed, I have summoned my people night and day
v.6: but my summons only increases their evasion.
v.7: Indeed whenever I have summoned them, so that You might forgive them, they would put their fingers into their ears and draw their cloaks over their heads, and they were persistent [in their unfaith], and disdainful in [their] arrogance.
v.9: and again appealed to them publicly and confided with them privately,
v.10: telling [them]: ‘‘Plead to your Lord for forgiveness. Indeed, He is all-forgiving.
v.11: He will send for you abundant rains from the sky,
v.12: and aid you with wealth and sons, and provide you with gardens and provide you with streams.
v.13: What is the matter with you that you do not look upon Allah with veneration,
v.14: though He has created you in [various] stages?
v.15: Have you not seen how Allah has created the seven heavens in layers,
v.16: and has made therein the moon for a light and the sun for a lamp?
v.17: Allah made you grow from the earth, with a [vegetable] growth.
v.18: Then He makes you return to it, and He will bring you forth [without fail].
v.19: Allah has made the earth a vast expanse for you
v.20: so that you may travel over its spacious ways.’’ ’
v.21: Noah said, ‘My Lord! They have disobeyed me, following someone whose wealth and children only add to his loss,
v.22: and they have devised an outrageous plot.
v.23: They say, ‘‘Do not abandon your gods. Do not abandon Wadd, nor Suwa, nor Yaghuth, Ya‘uq and Nasr,’’
v.24: and already they have led many astray. Do not increase the wrongdoers in anything but error.’
v.25: They were drowned because of their iniquities, then made to enter a Fire, and they did not find any helpers for themselves besides Allah.
v.26: And Noah said, ‘My Lord! ‘Do not leave on the earth any inhabitant from among the faithless.
v.27: If You leave them, they will lead astray Your servants, and will beget none except vicious ingrates.
v.28: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and the faithful men and women, and do not increase the wrongdoers in anything but ruin.’
